_note: Per-asset fixes read by turret_pack.py (raw px: mount in the 1024 body, muzzle within the 512 panel). S views aim at the camera, so the farthest-pixel rule finds the feet / carriage; their muzzle is the bore centre (cannon) or the arrow / bolt head (archer), read off the raw panel; the archers' SE arrow sits above their boots, which the rule would pick. Pairs (cannon-2 bores, archer-2 archers) use the midpoint. archer-2: its body has a roof, so the archers stand on the balcony floor (not the roof) at 0.8 scale to fit under the eave.
